name: qubika-livecoding-local
description: Local marketplace hosting the Qubika Livecoding plugin from this project directory

plugins.name: qubika-livecoding
plugins.description: Run live SQL interviews from your own terminal: one command starts a sandboxed SQL exercise app and prints an ephemeral public link to paste in the Meet chat, plus a live feed of every query the candidate runs. Ctrl+C kills the link. Embedded DuckDB, zero cost, full session log.
